create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Squamish
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Squamish is a small traditional Mysore shala on the second floor of a building on Cleveland Avenue in downtown Squamish, British Columbia. It is held by Natalia Correa, who was raised in Chile by Buddhist parents, found her way into yoga in her mid-twenties and began teaching in 2015. She holds Level 2 authorisation from the Sharath Yoga Centre in Mysore and names Sharath Jois, Sharmila Desai and Fiona Stang as her teachers.

The heart of the timetable is Mysore-style practice, where each student learns the sequence at a pace suited to them, alongside counted led classes and a monthly introductory workshop on breath, posture and gaze. The shala sets out four guiding principles, respect, connection, community and gratitude, and asks for consent before any hands-on adjustment. For those wanting to go further, Natalia runs an apprenticeship in three forms: a small online mentorship group with pranayama and shamata meditation, a six-to-twelve-month apprenticeship in the Mysore room, and a four-week summer immersion in 2027 built on daily morning practice, weekly satsanga with chanting and optional quiet sitting. Her short essays on practice, the Gita and the lineage are free on the site.

courses.title: Passes and memberships
courses.description: Drop-ins, a punch pass and monthly memberships for the shala's Mysore and led classes, with a reduced rate for students, seniors and full-time yoga teachers, and two starting options for newcomers: the Foundations Workshop or a two-week unlimited pass.
courses.price: Drop-in: $30; Friends Drop-in (2 people): $45; 5-Class Punch Pass: $132.30; One Month Unlimited: $189/month; Unlimited Membership: $170.10/month; Students, Seniors & Full-Time Yoga Teachers: $145/month; Foundations Workshop ($75.60); Two-Week Unlimited Pass ($113.40)

courses.title: Continuum: online mentorship
courses.description: Nine 90-minute online sessions in a small group with Natalia Correa, covering a deeper practice, an introduction to pranayama and shamata meditation, and the history of the lineage; recorded, with one individual session. A morning group starts on 27 January 2027 and an evening group runs from September 2027.

courses.title: Summer Student Immersion 2027
courses.description: Four weeks of daily morning Mysore practice in Squamish (minimum two weeks), with a weekly Saturday satsanga of pranayama, chanting and discussion and optional quiet sitting in the afternoons. Open to dedicated practitioners and to beginners who commit to all four weeks; entry by application.
courses.price: $85 CAD per two weeks (current studio members); others apply

free_resources.title: Full Primary Series of Ashtanga Yoga Led Class
free_resources.description: A free counted led class of the full primary series by Natalia Correa, giving each posture's name, its breath count and its gazing point, to support home practice.

free_resources.title: Tristhana
free_resources.description: A short free guide to the three focal points of Ashtanga practice, posture, breath and gaze, with the names of the eight gazing points used in the asana sequence.
